<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;0,9..40,600;0,9..40,700;1,9..40,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    :root {
      --teal: #02838D;
      --teal-dark: #026b74;
      --teal-light: #e6f5f6;
      --teal-muted: #a8dce0;
      --charcoal: #231F20;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #FAFBFB;
      --gray-100: #F3F5F6;
      --gray-200: #E8ECED;
      --gray-300: #D1D7D9;
      --gray-400: #9BA5A8;
      --gray-500: #6B7578;
      --gray-600: #4A5254;
      --coral: #E8734A;
      --coral-dark: #D4623B;
      --amber: #F5A623;
      --amber-light: #FFF8ED;
      --green-light: #E8F5E9;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      --transition: 0.2s ease;
      --max-width: 1200px;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    ul { list-style: none; }

    .container { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

    /* ============ HEADER ============ */
    .header {
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
    }

    .header-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .logo {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--teal);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: var(--teal);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-icon svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: var(--white); }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .header-actions a {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .header-actions a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    .btn-subscribe {
      padding: 8px 20px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white) !important;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .btn-subscribe:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

    /* Main Navigation */
    .main-nav {
      background: var(--white);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .nav-list {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .nav-item {
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-item > button {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 14px 20px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-item > button:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    .nav-item > button svg {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-item.open > button { color: var(--teal); }
    .nav-item.open > button svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    /* Mega Menu */
    .mega-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      padding: 24px 28px;
      min-width: 480px;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity 0.2s, visibility 0.2s;
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .nav-item.open .mega-menu {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .mega-menu h4 {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .mega-menu-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 8px 32px;
    }

    .mega-menu-grid a {
      font-size: 14px;
      padding: 6px 0;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      transition: color var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .mega-menu-grid a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    .mega-menu-section + .mega-menu-section {
      margin-top: 20px;
      padding-top: 20px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    /* ============ CREDIBILITY TICKER ============ */
    .ticker-bar {
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      padding: 10px 0;
    }

    .ticker-track {
      display: flex;
      animation: ticker-scroll 30s linear infinite;
      width: max-content;
    }

    .ticker-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }

    .ticker-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 40px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .ticker-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.8; }

    .ticker-separator {
      width: 4px;
      height: 4px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    @keyframes ticker-scroll {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    /* ============ HERO ============ */
    .hero {
      padding: 48px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .hero-main {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e6f5f6 0%, #d4eef0 50%, #c2e7ea 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 48px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 380px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      position: absolute;
      top: 24px;
      right: 24px;
      background: var(--coral);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      line-height: 1.3;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-badge span { display: block; font-size: 18px; }

    .hero-category {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: 32px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: 500px;
    }

    /* Trending sidebar */
    .trending-sidebar {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .trending-header {
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .trending-header h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .trending-header svg { color: var(--coral); width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    .trending-list { padding: 8px 0; }

    .trending-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 16px 24px;
      transition: background var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .trending-item:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .trending-number {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-300);
      line-height: 1;
      min-width: 30px;
    }

    .trending-content { flex: 1; }

    .trending-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--teal);

    .trending-title {

      font-weight: 600;

    /* ============ NEWSLETTER CTA ============ */

    .topic-bg-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d5d5e8, #e0e0f0); }
    .topic-bg-5 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d5e8e8, #e0f0f0); }

    /* ============ HEALTH TOOLS ============ */

      font-weight: 700;

    .tool-hub-header p {

      line-height: 1.5;
      margin-bottom: 16px;

    .btn-teal {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);

      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;

    .btn-teal:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }
    .btn-teal svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    .tool-list { padding: 8px 0; }

    .tool-item {

    .tool-item:hover { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .tool-icon {

      justify-content: center;

      font-size: 20px;

    .tool-icon-green { background: var(--green-light); }
    .tool-icon-amber { background: var(--amber-light); }
    .tool-icon-teal { background: var(--teal-light); }

    .tool-item-content h4 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;

    /* Drug & Care section */

      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .drug-tool-card p {
      font-size: 13px;

      line-height: 1.4;

    .drug-tool-card .tool-cta {

      gap: 4px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .drug-tool-card .tool-cta svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

    /* ============ RECOMMENDED READS ============ */
    .recommended-reads {
      padding: 64px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .tabs-bar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;

    .tab-btn {

    .read-card-body h3 {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 8px;

      text-align: center;

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

    .trust-card h3 {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;

    .trust-card p {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ============ FEATURED PROGRAMS ============ */
    .featured-programs {
      padding: 64px 0;
      background: var(--white);

    .programs-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

    }

    .program-card {

      align-items: center;

    .program-card-body h3 {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .prog-bg-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8eaf6, #c5cae9); }
    .prog-bg-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0f2f1, #b2dfdb); }
    .prog-bg-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }

      align-items: center;

    .footer-social a svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: var(--white); }

      .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .drug-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .footer-newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .section-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .header-actions .sign-in-link { display: none; }

    /* ============ UTILITY ============ */
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;

      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0,0,0,0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }

        const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');

        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(n => {
          n.classList.remove('open');
          n.querySelector('button').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });

        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('open');
          this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(n => {
        n.classList.remove('open');
        n.querySelector('button').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu').forEach(menu => {
      menu.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());
    });

    // Recommended Reads Tabs
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {

        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.classList.remove('active');
          b.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
        });
        this.classList.add('active');
        this.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

        const tabId = this.dataset.tab;
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => {
          content.classList.remove('active');
        });
        document.querySelector(`.tab-content[data-content="${tabId}"]`).classList.add('active');
      });
    });

    // Close mega menu on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(n => {
          n.classList.remove('open');
          n.querySelector('button').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
